questions.question: What did Job say he would do in the bitterness of his soul?
options: Stay silent and bear it alone
Give free utterance to his complaint
Flee far from the eyes of men
Praise God in spite of all his losses
questions.answer: Give free utterance to his complaint

questions.question: What did Job ask God not to do?
options: Bless him richly as he had so often done before
Condemn him; show him why he contends with him
Heal him at last of his many painful sores
Speak even a single word of reply to him
questions.answer: Condemn him; show him why he contends with him

questions.question: Job acknowledged that God's hands fashioned and made him.
Job said God had clothed him with skin and flesh and knit him with bones and _____.
Job asked God to remember that he made him like _____.
